post.summary: Set initial password for staff account
post.description: Consumes a valid password setup token sent via email and configures initial account password.
Registers a new customer account with an email, strong password, and full name. The email address must not be in use by another active account.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Authenticates an ACTIVE, email-verified customer and returns an access token (JWT) and a refresh token. Each login opens a new session, so several devices can be signed in at once. Send the optional X-Guest-Cart-Token header to have the guest cart merged. After 5 failed attempts per IP and email within 15 minutes the API answers 429 with Retry-After.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: malformed email or missing password

403.description: ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE or EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED (only after a correct password)

post.description: Regenerates setup token and resends invitation email to the staff member.

Creates a new DRAFT product (status=2) with variants, gallery images, and an optional
size chart reference. Inventory is initialised to zero for every variant.
Slugs and SKUs must be globally unique across all products, including deleted ones.
The referenced category and size chart (if supplied) must already exist.
Required authority: product:write.

Transitions a DRAFT product (status=2) to ACTIVE (status=1). The product must exist,
not be deleted, and have at least one active variant. No request body is required.
Required authority: product:write.
